name: Heward's Handy Spice Pouch

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Take a pinch

params.text: yields a pinch of whatever seasoning you name

powers.text: It yields a pinch of whatever seasoning you name. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: 10 charges: a pinch of any seasoning you like.
text: A belt pouch that looks empty yet holds 10 charges. As a Magic action while holding it, spend 1 charge and name any nonmagical seasoning, such as cilantro, saffron, pepper or salt, then draw out a pinch of it, enough to flavour one meal. Each dawn, the pouch recovers 1d6 + 4 spent charges.
